name: Пастки: усунення захисника + WM
description: In this lesson, we continue focusing on disabling a defender with the aim of delivering checkmate. We now concentrate on the methods of driving away and luring away. It remains important to consider the basic forms of defense (moving away, covering, capturing, and interposing) as well as counterattacks, so the opponent cannot escape material loss.

examples.text:
Both 1.Nb2 and 1.Nc5 attack the defender of the checkmate square e8. However, 1.Nb2 (red arrow) is not sufficient. After 1...Bd7, Black moves the bishop and continues to defend e8.

1.Nc5! is the solution. White attacks the bishop and also takes away the d7 square. White will win the bishop or deliver checkmate if Black moves the bishop: 1...Bc2 2.Re8#.

texts: Drive away a key defender. Always ask yourself: what can the opponent do in response?
